COD.rationale: Identified content (red at p0/current/n3), an origin/status label for that entry, and grid/presentation information are explicitly present and bound to the current referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition or change is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: The text explicitly identifies content tokens (red, blue) with coordinate sets (locations) for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) explicitly attribute different provenance/status to identified content entries.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (coordinate sets) and supplies a grid orientation rule; entries are labeled current vs candidate (access/presentation).
